issue.title: test_project_help_golden fails on Python 3.12 because project_help.txt duplicates the repo legend and example
issue.description: Discovered by sase-1nn.8.land at 102c6ee847215d0e813532329fb8af48a0ad29b7. tests/stats/golden/cli/project_help.txt contains two identical By repo definitions and two identical repos[] jq examples; parser_stats.py and registry.py emit each once. project_help_py313.txt already has one each, which is why Python 3.13/3.14 Full CI passes. Repair the Python 3.12 golden using its interpreter and verify parser tests on 3.12 and 3.13+. The remaining release integration child under sase-1nn.8 owns this small repair; avoid duplicate workers. Existing sase-14p concerns argparse metavar spelling, a different defect. Evidence: Master Gate 40058175796 attempt 2 job 120769167380 and Full CI 40063272183 job 120783473758.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical mismatch in Master Gate rerun and Full CI 3.12; git show 102c6ee847 proves two duplicate golden additions while production emits each once.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1nn.8 landing audit found this new deterministic Master Gate and Full CI regression from non-epic commit 102c6ee847; no existing task owns its duplicate-line root cause.
